request: Reusable assessment scoring and SDC-extracted score Observations; CQL independent of Questionnaire and QuestionnaireResponse

decisions.algorithm: Authored count of Yes answers, 0..3; not a CDC-defined numeric scale
decisions.riskThreshold: >= 1 per CDC any-Yes rule; optional clarification unanswered
decisions.completion: Exactly one valid final integer score Observation in range 0..3 with qualifying encounter and effective time; zero is complete
decisions.missingness: No score for incomplete or unusable inputs
decisions.interoperability: Same coded score from another source must work without Questionnaire, QuestionnaireResponse, or derivedFrom
decisions.automatedScoringScope: Reusable scoring contract and reviewed authoring pattern. Implemented automatic generator supports complete Boolean answer counts; other algorithms require explicit reviewed implementation.

publishing: Local branches only; no push, merge, deployment or protected source mutation

verified.referenceTranslation: CQFramework 3.26.0; both exact sources; translation only

limitations: FHIR validator 6.10.2 reports MEASURE_MR_SCORE_REQUIRED for the younger zero-denominator MeasureReport; strict runtime validation remains false. No other runtime validation errors.
Assessment staging is scoped to the same browser tab.
Run005 is a declared revision of frozen earlier authoring work, not a new independent authoring benchmark.
Final API matrix does not re-run an isolated missing-dependency negative snapshot; prior negative/unit evidence remains separate.
Browser late-response guards were inspected in code; forced network-delay behavior was not separately exercised.
